description: IPA-transliterated perception snippets used for zero-shot CE evaluation in the SCiL 2026 v2 paper. Source files renamed from transliteration_{lang}_ipa_{timestamp}.txt to perception_{lang}.txt to match scripts.zero_shot_eval default template.
notes: No Finnish file: Finnish is the typological control in the LSTM experiments, not a Turkic perception target.

perception_uz.txt has 19 passages, not 20: TEXT 2 ('Catching a cold') passage 5 was deliberately excluded by Moldir because its audio recording was removed due to speaker disfluency (confirmed 2026-06-12). The model eval correctly scores the 19 passages that human listeners actually heard; do NOT reconstruct the missing passage.

Each file contains multiple TEXT N sections separated by headers and 1..5 section markers; these constitute under 5 percent of total chars and are kept as-is so all six files share the same metadata pattern.

Char inventory check at receipt: 41-60 unique chars per file, zero Cyrillic leak across all six, Uyghur contains 51 Arabic-script punctuation chars (Arabic comma/question/semicolon) preserved from source orthography.
